verdict.rationale: AgentMail is API-first: inboxes can be created and operated entirely via API, and agents can self-register to get an API key. It also offers SDKs, a published OpenAPI spec, and an official CLI shipped as a single native binary with no runtime dependencies, which suits headless and scripted automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline docs or examples, documented non-interactive CLI auth (e.g., env-var API keys), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.
